title: Personal Mac — NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Low (tailored, audit-only)

tailoring.rationale: Low-friction controls that can be assessed reliably on a standalone personal Apple Silicon Mac without MDM.

rules.title: Enable macOS Application Firewall
rules.guidance: Enable Firewall in System Settings > Network > Firewall after reviewing inbound application access.

rules.title: Enable Firewall Stealth Mode
rules.guidance: Enable stealth mode in Firewall Options after enabling the application firewall.

rules.title: Enable Gatekeeper
rules.guidance: Keep application assessments enabled and approve exceptional software individually.

rules.title: Enable System Integrity Protection
rules.guidance: SIP changes require Recovery; investigate why it is disabled before changing it.

rules.title: Install critical security updates automatically
rules.guidance: Enable automatic security responses and system data files in Software Update settings.

rules.title: Keep macOS software updates current
rules.guidance: Review and install recommended macOS updates from System Settings.

rules.title: Lock an inactive session within 15 minutes
rules.guidance: Set the display/screen saver inactivity timeout to 900 seconds or less.

rules.title: Require authentication after screen saver
rules.guidance: This repository manages askForPassword=1 in its hardening baseline.

rules.title: Require authentication immediately after lock
rules.guidance: This repository manages askForPasswordDelay=0 in its hardening baseline.

rules.title: Disable automatic login
rules.guidance: Disable automatic login in Login Options.

rules.title: Disable the guest account
rules.guidance: Disable Guest User unless anonymous local access is explicitly required.

rules.title: Disable Screen Sharing when unused
rules.guidance: Disable Screen Sharing unless it is intentionally used and access is controlled.

rules.title: Disable Remote Management when unused
rules.guidance: Disable Apple Remote Desktop management unless it is explicitly required.

rules.title: Disable Remote Login when unused
rules.guidance: Disable Remote Login unless SSH access is intentionally required and hardened.

rules.title: Enable the time synchronization daemon
rules.guidance: Keep the macOS timed service enabled for reliable timestamps.

rules.title: Enable FileVault
rules.guidance: Enable FileVault manually only after choosing and verifying a recovery-key strategy.
